༷:/ 7gongs7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (211)ba 'bo ba'i cadag nas bshad na ma gdo/gas bshad khag lhu/ yin/ masnga ra ro/na phyi'i 'byung ba lnga sku da pa gang shi dbang shis 'byung ngam zhe na/ pha(smu cher las kyi dbang gis byung ba red ces bswā da dbo sa min mi shes/ de ni rang bzhin red ces bswārd dbo/sa pa min nam snyam/ shes pa gsal rig gi sngor bor sku da pa dang / gzugs can dang gzugs can ma yin pa'i thodas gnyis sku da pa de gang gis byas sam zhe na/ las kyi dbang gis red ces brjod rgyu phal cher med/ de ni rang bzhin dang chos nyid red ces brjod dgos pa yin /des na nga rang snurar rig pa bzhi'i nang khyodas nyid kyi rig pa zhes pa zhig yod/ der brten dper na phyi stod kyi bkod pa gzugs can de dag kyang / sa chu me rlung gi 'byung ba rags pa de dag je phrar phyin pa dang / 'byung ba phra snu/ las yang 'byung ba rags pa rnams tshur skyes pa bcas de ltar char nub byed pa ni/ dus nges can zhig gi nang sku nga ba dang / de lta bu'i bcud kyi sems can ni spyi mthun gyi las kyi dbang gis yong ba dang / sdod kyi bkod pa gang zhig chags min/ mdor na bcud kyi sems cad rnams la bde sdug gi snurar ba sku nga ba'i rkyen ni/skabs de'i 'gro ba'i las dang phal cher 'brel ba yod/ spyir rgyu dang

(212) bshes pa'i spring yig gi bka' khrid/ —— —'bras bur 'bo ba ni las kyi dbang gis byung ba gang yang min par de ni dngos wa'i chos nyid yin/ 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can zhig yin na / de ni rgyu rkyen la brten nas 'gyur ba 'thod ba dang / rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas sku nga ba ni/ dacadas wa'i chos nyid dang gshis lugs yin pa las de la las 'bras kyi skad cha gang yang med/las zhes pa ni spyi'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'gro stangs kyi nang tshan nas/ bye brag byed pa ngo zhig gi kun nā nga gi khyad par dang 'brel ba'i swāpeg nas byed pa gsar du sgrub pa de la las zhes skad cha bshad kyi yod/stod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi chags 'jig shi nang ji tsam las kyis byed kyi yod pa dang / ji tsam zhig chos nyid kyi thog nas 'gro gi yod pa de dag la dbye ba phye rgyu sku da/ zhib tshags sngo bshad thub rgyu khag sngo yin la ngas mi shes/ de nas 〉rtom lam gyi skabs su 'phags lam yan lag bdun gsungs pa ni/yang dag lta dang 'tsho dang rtsol ba dang / /dran dang nying 'dzin ngag dang las mtha' dang / /yang dag 〈snag nyid lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /'di ni zhi bar bgyi slad bsnyodam par bgyi/ /

sdu:mi 7gongs7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (213)zhes gsungs pa ltar yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang /yang dag pa'i ting 'dzin dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i dodag pa nyid de 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ni zhi bar bgyi slad de sdug kun nye bar zhi ba'i slad du balha ma par bgyi zhes gsungs/ gong du gsungs ma thag pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la lha/gas pa de dag tshur bsngudzhaskabs/skye 'di 3cug bsngal sred pa zhes bgyi ba/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin nye bar len pa'i phung wa'i skye ba 'di sdug bsngal bden pa dang / kun 'byung / las nyon/ nyon mongs kyi sred pa bcas gathor thod yin pas sred pa'i ming blo sa nas des maco na pa'i thodan snu ngas pa'i kun chodang dang / des bsags pa'i las kyi kun 'byung zhes bgyi ba de ni/ sdug bsngal gyi phung wa'i skye ba de yi kun nas 'byung ba'i rgyu yin te/de ni de yi kun 'byung rgya chen te/ /'di 'bo ga pa ni thar pa lags te lam/ /

(214) bshes pa'ispringayigagibaka'akhrid/ khu zhes gsungs pa ltar de lta bu'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal bskyed byed kyi rgyu kun 'byung bkag cing sgong ba'i sgo nas de lta bu'i sdug bsngal bkag pa'i 'gog pa 'di ni thar pa lags te/ de lta bu'i sdug kun nye bar zhi ba'i thar pa de jo ba par bgyi ba'i lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ni lam gyi bden pa yin pas/de lnga ba 'phags lam yan lag de brgyad lags/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi wa dag /mthong bar bgyi slad rtag tu brtson par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar de lta bu'i tshul la bslabs na/pang na dpal gnas khyim pa rnams kyis kya nga / /shes pas therdzon mo ngas chu 1— las brgal bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin pang na dpal zhes pa ni bu la ba༄༄da kyi yod/ de yang spyir btang khyim pa so sor khyim shul 'dzin mkhan gyi bu la rtsachen sngo ra brtsi bas pang na dpal te bu gnas pa'i khyim pa ho snu rnams kyis kyang / de lta bu'i bden bzhi spyi dang bye brag gi tshul legs par shes pa byas nas/tho/na snu/ngas pa'i chu ro/ las brgal bar gyis shig gam brgal bar bgyilo/ zhes sku //

hā:rdo 7gongs7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (215)rgyu mtshan ni/ khyim du gnas nas khyim pa'i 'a〉rga ba skyel mkhan zhig yin yang / bden bzhi spyi dang bye brag gi tshul rnams shes pa'i sgo nas/ nyon mongs pa'i chu bo las brgal bar bgyi 'os shing / gang lags she na/gang dag chodas malnga na bgyis pa de dag kyang / /gnam las babs pa ma lags 'e1 lnga(ga bzhin/ /sa rum nas 'asgyu na ma lags de dag spyodan/ /snyadan mongs rag las skye bo kho nar bas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skye bo gang dag thar pa'i chos mngon du bgyis pa ste/ mdor na thar pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas zin pa'i skye 17 de dag kyang /jo/ga ma nas spangs dodags mthar phyin pa byas nas gnam nas babs pa ma lags shing / yang sba/ do/ga bzhin du sa rum nas 'chodan pa yang ma lags/ de dag sngon nyon mongs rag las zhes so so skye bo bas te so so khye bo yin pa de las gzhan du med ces gsungs shing / der bas zhes pa ni de la zer zhes dang / de ga rang red ces pa'i don yin/des na da lta dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa tshang ma sngon nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can gyi so so skye bo nga rang tsho nang

(216) bshes pa'ispringayigagibaka'akhrid/ sgulasasgo ༄༄bzhin gcig rim bzhin bden bzhi phra rags te bden bzhi spyi dang bye brag gi tshul rnams shes shing / spang blang 'jug ldog ma nor bar brtsams pa'i 'bras bur thar pa mngon du byas pa red ces so//bsnyengs dang bral la mang du gasku la ci 'tshal /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsnyengs pa'am 'jigs pa ste bsnyengs dang bral ba khyod la mang du gsol ci dgos te/phan pa'i gdams ngag don po 'di lags te—/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phan pa'i gdams ngag gi snying wa'i snying po gang zhe na/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis nam du yang gsungs pa dang / stodan pa'i rjes 'brang mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug thams cad kyis mgrin dbyangs gcig gis gsungs pa zhi/ sems dul dbo/sa zhes pa de red ces gsungs so//khyedad kyi thugs dul malhu da cig bce ma ldan gyis/ /sems ni snungs kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar sangs rgyas ba3)ma ldan 'das kyis sems dul ba ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags zhes gsungs so//khyedad la de skad gdams pa gang lags de/ /

༷:/ 7gongs7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (217)bas par dge lhu nga gis kyang bgyi bar dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin khyod la ngas da lta gdams pa yongs su swā gas pa zhig bas par zhes pa ni thams cad dam ma lus pa lus pa med pa dang / de bas zhes ba6wad pa ni der thams cad 'dus pa'am/de kho nar nges pa de bshad kyi sku da pas na/ bas pa zhes thams cad ni / spyir dge slong zhig gis kyang bgyi bar dka' ba yin/ de lta na yang /'di las gang zhig spyod pa'i ngo bo de'i/ /yodan tan bsten pas sku tshe don yodad mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin bslab bya gsungs pa de dag gi nang nas rgyal sngo rang nyid kyis nyams len ci thub gnang thub na/ sku tshe snga na dang ldan pa byung ba red ces gsungs pa yin/ de nas bsngo ba gsungs pa ཿdo/kun gyi dge ba kun la yi rang zhing / /zhes gsungs pa ltar so so skye bo dang / 'phags pa'i stogs mtha' dag gis dge ba kun la rjes su yi rang zhing /nyid kyis legs par spyad pa rnam gsum yang / /

(218ri/ bshes pa'ispringayigagibaka'akhrid/ — ——sgo gsum gyi dge ba dang bcas pa yang /sangs rgyas nyid sgyu ba bgyi slad sku ngas ba3ges nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dge ba tshe 'di'i ched du dang / phyi ma mngon mtho'i bde 'bras kyi ched du dang / thar pa thob pa'i ched du bsngo ba ma yin par/ sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i slad du yongs su bsngos ca//5/de nas dge ba'i phung po 'di yis khyod/ /skye ba dpag tu med pa lha mi yi/ /'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyudad pa yis/ /skye lnga nyams thag mang wa rjes bzung ste/ /'khrungs nas na rga 'a〈snad chags zhe sdang rnams/ /bsal te sangs rgyas zhing du bsgu ma ldan 'das/ /'od dpag med dang 'dra bar 'jig rten gyi/ /mgon po sku tshe dpag tu med par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar de lta bu'i bsngo ba skyon gnang mdzad na/bde nas bde bar mngon mtho lha mi'i lus rten rim par thob pa dang /

sdu:spya 7gongs7skyabs mgon chen po mchog (219)de dag brgyud nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang shi ྅7da pa zhes pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rjodad pa la gsung gi sku da/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas 'gro ba nyam thag pa mang po rjes su bzung ste/mthar srid pa mtha' ma'i skabs nas byang sems srid mthar 'khrungs nas mthar skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang / de kun nas slong byed kyi 'asnga da chags zhe sdang la sku gas pa bag chags dang bcas pa bsal nas dang / yang na byang chub sems dpa' srid pa mtha' ma pa lam ma11na sngo ra slebs na/ na rga'i sdug bsngal dang / de bzhin 'dod chags zhe sdang gi kun 'byung dang bcas pa thams cad bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag med dang 'dra bar zhes pa ni/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang / mdor na/ bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bathegam ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag med dang 'dra bar 'jig rten gyi mgon po mngon du mdzad nas/ ji srid nam mkha' ma zad kyi bar la sems can gyi ro/na mdzad pa yong gi red ces pa'i don min nam snyam/shes rab tshul khrims gtong 'byung grags chen dri ma med//zhes gsungs pa ltar shes rab dang / tshul khrims dang / gtong

(220) bshes pa'ispringayigagibaka'akhrid/ tsārjosde —ba las byung ba'i grags pa chen ho/ ste/ sku na tan med pa'i rgyab la grags pa che/ /zhes pa lta bu min par grags pa don dang ldan pa/lha yul nam mkha' dang ni sa steng rgyas mdzad nas/ /sa la mi dang mthe ris lha ni na chung mchodag /bde dgas dga' ba nges par rab tu zhi mdzad de/ /〈snan mosnangs nyam thag sems can tshorags kyi 'jigs skye dang //'chi ba zhi mdzad rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid brnyes nas/ /'jig rten las 'das ming tsam zhi la mi brnyengs pa/ /mi bgres nongs pa mi mnga'i go 'phang brnyes par mdzod//ces gsungs pa ni rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i bo 'phang bsgrub pa de gsung gi yod/bshes pa'i spring yig che ba dpon 'phags pa kru sgrub kyis rgyal po mdza' bo bde bhyod la bskur ba rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang / nu chen gyi lo tsā ba brje dpal brtsegs kyis bsgrur cing zhus te gtan la phab pacas// //

phyag deb 'di'i zhu dag pa/rnam grwa'i dpe 'khrid dge bshes/ thub bstan tshul khrims lags/blo gling rgyal pa dge bshes/ ngag dbang sangs rgyas lags/rgyab sha jus 'god pa/rnam grwa sgra brnyan sde tshan gyi las byed/ bstan 'dzin don yod/phab sgyur dang / deb gzugs jus 'god/rnam grwa thub bstan yar 'phel/༄༄/ /bod mi btsan byol du 'byor nas mi lo 50 tham pa hril por 'khor ba'i rjes dran srung brtsi'i ched sku bcar rnam par rgyal ba phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang gi shes yon lhan tshogs nas deb grangs 2000 tham pa dpar 'grems zhus//
ṅka
